protocol.loss: Four-step free-running position/velocity MSE using fixed scales [1,1,3,3], plus0.02 Gaussian innovation NLL on velocity residuals; no held-out labels or tuning. Gradient clip1, final update160, no checkpoint selection.
protocol.uncertainty: 32 fixed-seed trajectory particles with persistent hidden mass/material prior and observation noise; learned independent per-step velocity noise, paired position noise dt/2. Full empirical12x12 covariance and marginal quantiles, no posthoc widening. Terminal quadratic risk is squared mean distance plus positional covariance trace. Nonlinear contact uncertainty is sampled, not linearized. Monte Carlo resolution limits95% tails.
protocol.observations: Four noisy public observations and masks; velocities missing are differenced from observed positions. Hidden mass/friction/restitution use nominal1/.2/.5 for learning and persistent priors uniform[.8,1.8]/[.1,.4]/[.4,.95] at prediction. Gravity,spring,dt,elapsed time,object radius and active status public. Training has future-state targets; inference does not. Prior actions are not supplied or inferred as hidden truth. Future action schedule is public hypothetical input.
protocol.planning: Nine fixed initial impulses [-2,0,2]x[-2,0,2], horizon32, target [1.5,1.0], expected squared terminal position error plus trace covariance. One chosen action independently executed from public-history origin in Pymunk; success distance<=0.75. No simulator calls during selection. Compare per-scene seed-averaged success against strongest control on same scenes.
protocol.aggregation: Independent scene as unit; average seeds within each scene before equal-weight scene means; separate family and OOD-stratum tables. 2000 fixed-seed paired scene bootstrap for OOD MSE ratio and planning difference. Primary gates require point criteria AND bootstrap upper ratio<1/lower planning difference>0. Horizons are correlated diagnostics, not extra scenes. All gates apply per family; no favorable family pooling.
protocol.scope: 1..3 circles,fixed floor,one explicitly indexed spring between objects0/1; known rest1.5,damping.3. Approximate contact prior and antisymmetric learned radial forces; momentum conservation only for internal pair forces, not gravity/floor/friction or hidden nominal-mass mismatch. Unsupported rotations/shapes/fluid/real-world regimes. Legacy reference uses motion memory and interaction concepts seeds11/23 final160 checkpoints, selected only from archived V3.1 development_stress horizon32 seed-mean MSE before new outcomes; different historical data/budget makes it a frozen-reference comparison, not matched retraining.
protocol.decision: Fail integrity or qualification: stop without training, preserve DATA_NO_GO or FAILED_CAMPAIGN. All scientific gates pass: GO_TO_CONFIRMATION; otherwise NO_GO. No retries, extra fits, threshold changes, OOD calibration or holdout selection. Native MPS only.
